description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing SHA1 hashing using hardware acceleration on Infineon Lantiq (Danube) platform. Contains functions for initializing, updating, finalizing SHA1 hashes, and hardware interaction routines.

classes.name: sha1_ctx
classes.description: Private context structure for SHA1 hashing, including state variables, counters, and buffer.

methods.name: sha1_transform1
methods.description: Main hardware interface to process a 64-byte block for SHA1 transformation.

methods.name: sha1_update
methods.description: Processes input data on-the-fly, updating the SHA1 hash state.

methods.name: sha1_final
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA1 hash computation, producing the digest.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_sha1
methods.description: Registers the SHA1 hash algorithm with the kernel crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_sha1
methods.description: Unregisters the SHA1 hash algorithm from the kernel crypto API.
